commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
HOST=michal@192.168.0.23
STAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S')
DEST_DIR="$HOME/Desktop"
DEST="$DEST_DIR/PhotoMaps-app-db-$STAMP.sqlite"
PART="$DEST.part"
REMOTE="/tmp/PhotoMaps-app-db-$STAMP.sqlite"
REMOTE_DIAG="/tmp/PhotoMaps-backup-diagnostics-$STAMP.json"
mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
rm -f "$PART"
cleanup() {
  rm -f "$PART"
  ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" "rm -f '$REMOTE' '$REMOTE_DIAG'" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

echo '=== VERIFY LOCAL/PRODUCTION REVISION ==='
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" "cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && test '\$(git rev-parse HEAD)' = '$EXPECTED' && test '\$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)' = active && test -f backend/data/app.db"

echo '=== PROJECT DIAGNOSTICS + ONLINE SQLITE SNAPSHOT ==='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" "REMOTE_SNAPSHOT='$REMOTE' REMOTE_DIAG='$REMOTE_DIAG' bash -s" <<'REMOTE_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/diagnose_local_data.py --output-json "$REMOTE_DIAG" >/dev/null
REMOTE_DIAG="$REMOTE_DIAG" backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
r = json.loads(Path(os.environ['REMOTE_DIAG']).read_text())
issues = r['summary']['issues']['by_severity']
storage = r['summary']['storage']
assert issues['error'] == 0, issues
assert storage['orphan_private_files'] == 0, storage
assert storage['orphan_public_files'] == 0, storage
print('project_diagnostics=ok')
PY
REMOTE_SNAPSHOT="$REMOTE_SNAPSHOT" backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
src_path = Path('backend/data/app.db')
dst_path = Path(os.environ['REMOTE_SNAPSHOT'])
dst_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
src = sqlite3.connect(f'file:{src_path}?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=30)
dst = sqlite3.connect(dst_path)
try:
    src.backup(dst)
    integrity = dst.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    assert integrity == 'ok', integrity
    version = dst.execute('SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version').fetchone()[0]
    photos = dst.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo').fetchone()[0]
    places = dst.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place').fetchone()[0]
    print(f'remote_snapshot_integrity={integrity} alembic={version} photos={photos} places={places}')
finally:
    src.close()
    dst.close()
PY
sha256sum "$REMOTE_SNAPSHOT"
stat -c 'remote_snapshot_bytes=%s' "$REMOTE_SNAPSHOT"
REMOTE_SCRIPT

REMOTE_SHA=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" "sha256sum '$REMOTE' | awk '{print \\$1}'")
test -n "$REMOTE_SHA"

echo '=== COPY SNAPSHOT TO MAC DESKTOP ==='
scp -q -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST:$REMOTE" "$PART"
LOCAL_META=$(python3 - "$PART" <<'PY'
import hashlib
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(sys.argv[1])
conn = sqlite3.connect(p)
try:
    integrity = conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    assert integrity == 'ok', integrity
    version = conn.execute('SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version').fetchone()[0]
    photos = conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo').fetchone()[0]
    places = conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place').fetchone()[0]
finally:
    conn.close()
h = hashlib.sha256()
with p.open('rb') as f:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
        h.update(chunk)
print(f'{h.hexdigest()} {p.stat().st_size} {version} {photos} {places}')
PY
)
set -- $LOCAL_META
LOCAL_SHA=$1
LOCAL_BYTES=$2
LOCAL_VERSION=$3
LOCAL_PHOTOS=$4
LOCAL_PLACES=$5
test "$LOCAL_SHA" = "$REMOTE_SHA"
mv "$PART" "$DEST"

ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$HOST" "rm -f '$REMOTE' '$REMOTE_DIAG'"
trap - EXIT INT TERM

echo '=== BACKUP COMPLETE ==='
echo "backup_path=$DEST"
echo "backup_bytes=$LOCAL_BYTES"
echo "backup_sha256=$LOCAL_SHA"
echo "backup_integrity=ok"
echo "backup_alembic=$LOCAL_VERSION"
echo "backup_photos=$LOCAL_PHOTOS backup_places=$LOCAL_PLACES"
echo "production_head=$EXPECTED"
echo "production_service=active"
test -f "$DEST"
echo database_backup_to_desktop_verified
